name: web-red-fashion-site-on-monitor-with-model-on-chair
title: Red Fashion Site with Model on Chair
whatItIs: A cover with a pale grey ground, a monitor showing a deep red fashion website, a model in a pale suit seated on a chrome chair in front of it, and giant faint 'Dressiva' lettering across the top.
whatItMeans: The model in front of the screen ties the site to the brand's fashion world, and the deep red screen glows against the pale room.
techniques: Real model composited in front of the monitor
Deep red site as the colour anchor
Pale wardrobe against a red screen
Ghost brand name across the top
Chrome furniture as a styling prop

vocabulary.definition: A device and a person photo combined in one scene.
A pale subject set against a dark saturated field.
A furniture item chosen to support the mood.
